name: 結華
text:
……プロデューサーもそう思う？
──……なのに負けちゃったなぁ……
trans:
...You think so too?
Even though I still lost in the end...

name: プロデューサー
text:
結華は間違いなく素晴らしかった
……ただ、その上をいく人がいただけだ
trans:
There's no doubt that you were incredible out there.
It's just... someone went even further today.

name: 結華
text: ──だったら、三峰ももっと上にいけばいい？
trans: ──So I have to go even further than that, do I?

name: プロデューサー
text:
結華がダメだったわけじゃないっていうのを、
ちゃんと認識しておいてほしい
trans:
But I want to make sure you know that you didn't
do anything wrong out there.

name: プロデューサー
text: 俺は今日、いいものを見たよ
trans: I witnessed something amazing in you today.

name: 結華
text:
……あはは
負けだけど、ダメじゃない、か……──
trans:
Ahaha...
I lost, but that doesn't mean I failed... huh...

name: 結華
text:
……でも、そういう評価をもらえるってことは、
ちゃんと覚えておく
trans:
......But if that's the kind of feedback I'm getting,
then I'll be sure to keep it with me.

name: 結華
trans: ───I'll just have to push myself even harder!
